statistics_policy.mean: Only candidates with all four metrics; equal target weighting
statistics_policy.best: Post-hoc per-metric optimum; candidate budgets affect comparability; not one best structure
statistics_policy.common: Intersection of valid targets across all displayed tools, separately for each statistical view
statistics_policy.confidence: Not calibrated across tools; excluded from cross-tool ranking
statistics_policy.rank1: Not published: native ranking is absent, non-unique, or semantically inconsistent across methods
